result.topic_en: Gauss analyses the optics of his Fraunhofer telescope (Zugfernrohr): focal lengths, apertures and lens distances of the objective and four eyepieces, ray-tracing coefficients depending on a parameter x, the adjustment for a myopic eye, magnification, field of view, eyepiece apertures and the coloured fringe.

methods.what: Table of focal lengths, apertures and distances of telescope lenses (objective and four eyepieces)
Linear-in-x ray-tracing coefficients (alpha, beta, gamma, delta) for each lens surface/element
Focusing condition for a myopic eye with far point t, solved logarithmically for the draw-tube parameter x
Experimental magnification as ratio of apparent to true angular size
Field of view expressed as an angle and as a ratio
Estimate of the chromatic (coloured) fringe by summing contributions and scaling by dispersion ratio

items.quote:
Gesichtsweite eines myopischen Auges = t
Muss seyn $\beta^{iv}\delta^{iv}t + 1 = 0$.
items.english: Visual range of a myopic eye = t. It must be that beta^iv delta^iv t + 1 = 0.
